title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode4 Thoughtful Greetings

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi, allow me to introduce you to my friends, Minori and Kohane. They'll be joining us for the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm Minori Hanasato!
Nice to meet you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
I'm Nene Kusanagi. It's nice to meet you too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And I'm Kohane Azusawa...!
I sing street music most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-Nice to meet you...
Wait, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, it's me...!
I didn't realize that the friend Ichika mentioned would be you, Kusanagi...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Do you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we do! I go to Phoenix Wonderland all the time to see the shows Kusanagi and her troupe put on...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm so happy that we finally get a chance to talk like this...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Q-Quit exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. What a nice coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it really is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Anyway... Hanasato and Azusawa, right?
Again, it's nice to nice to meet the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hanasato, I heard that you're an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm trying to become an idol who can spread hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope we can become really good friends, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, right... I'd like that too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks, Nene!
Let's do our best for the Fan Festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
She's so talkative...
I guess she really is an idol...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, she has a very bright personality. So much so that she's able to cheer everyone up around her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's also a very hard-working girl. Despite being in an idol group, she's the only one without any prior experience working as one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's using the Fan Festival as an opportunity to grow as an idol and catch up to her groupmates.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I still have to depend on them when we're on stage so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But your determination's really commendable...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's not true at all!
It's always been my dream to become an idol. That's why I want to keep finding ways to get better at it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others work really hard too and have actual experience as idols on top of that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to catch up to them as quickly as I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree, so let's give it our all.
I'll help in any way I can too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Me three...
I don't really know much about being an idol, but I'd like to help...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seeing how determined you are has lit something inside of me too... So let's do our best, together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do what we can and make our Fan Festival performance a big success!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, shall we get started?
Or rather, what does an idol need to practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... Singing for one, but choreographing a dance routine and learning it once it's done... There's so much to do...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right, idols have to know how to dance too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Haruka and Airi are usually the ones who come up with our dance routines, so this will be my first time actually coming up with one on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to do as much as I can by myself, but I've been having so much trouble wrapping my head around how to actually choreograph a dance...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
As much as I'd like to help, I don't know much about dancing or choreography.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've danced before in some of our performances, but I'd hardly make a suitable teacher...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on!
Kusanagi, don't your shows usually involve some dancing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, a little...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They do, but I'm pretty sure that what we do isn't something you'd see idols doing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, I'm not the one who comes up with those dance routines. Rui... I mean, our director is a better person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, would you mind if I did ask him and your troupe for help...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, I'm guessing they'll be more than happy to help you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?! Thank you so much, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
U-Um, Kusanagi...
Would it be possible for me to join her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, me too...!
I'd love to see how you and your troupe practice, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I can't really make any guarantees...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'll talk to my troupe about you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you, Nene!
I think you just saved my dance routine...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That just leaves singing...
I hope practicing on my own like usual will be enough...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My teammates may be able to help you with that. They're all very good singers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They might have some advice for you, so I'll ask if they'd mind helping us during practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You will?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course. Would you two like to join as well?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If possible, yes...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me too.
These sort of opportunities are pretty rare so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll make sure to ask them later!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It'll also probably be good to get a head start on this. Assuming things work out, you'll be welcome to join us for practice three days from now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, practice with my troupe will probably be four days from now, so practice with your team will come first in all likelihood...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you so much, both of you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm stepping out of my idol shell for the very first time. I can't wait to see how everyone else practices!)
